## Amendment by the filing seat — the count in the body is UNDERSTATED, and one of its citations was taken off the wrong tree. 2026-09-22T06:44Z

Every reading below was taken by this seat after filing, and each corrects or strengthens the body rather than restating it.

### ① The autonumber arm is DECLARED contract, not an accident

`packages/spec/src/data/autonumber-format.ts:176-179` declares the source shape, and its own docblock names the key:

> A field declaration, as far as autonumber formatting is concerned. Both spellings appear in real metadata: `autonumberFormat` is the spec-canonical key, **`format` the shorthand that predates it (#1603)**.

```ts
export interface AutonumberFormatSource {
  autonumberFormat?: unknown;
  format?: unknown;
}
```

⇒ the body's 「the engine reads it as an autonumber pattern」 is weaker than the truth: the shorthand is written into the contract's own type, with a resolver whose docblock calls itself 「the ONE place the contract default is applied」.

### ② Two consumers on that arm, not one

`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts:10632` and `:10737` call the same `resolveAutonumberFormat`. So the autonumber reading of `field.format` is honoured by **the engine and the SQL driver**, which is why the resolver exists at all.

### ③ objectui holds TWO readings of its own — and they disagreed until last month

⛔ The body cited this arm off a sibling objectui checkout at `0cf2d66`. **That is not the tree this repo builds against.** Re-taken at the pin `.objectui-sha` = `87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2` (`git cat-file -t` resolves it; the checkout's own HEAD resolves as the control leg). At the pin:

| site | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1127` | the **date** cell — `const style = dateField.format \|\| 'relative';` |
| `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1184` | the **datetime** cell — `const authoredFormat = (field as DateTimeFieldMetadata \| undefined)?.format \|\| 'compact';` — **a different default for the same key** |
| `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1174-1184` | the comment that makes it explicit: 「`field.format` is ONE authored key, and until this mapping it meant two different things depending on which of two neighbouring cell renderers read it」 — measured end to end through a real `ObjectGrid` column, one row, one instant, `format: 'relative'` on both fields: the date cell painted `In 2 days`, the datetime cell beside it painted `Sep 11, 2026, 09:30 AM`, **no error, no warning, no fallback** (mapped at objectui#8853) |

⇒ ⭐ **The count in the body is understated.** It is not one key with three vocabularies; it is one key with at least **four** readings — autonumber pattern, date display style (default `relative`), datetime display style (default `compact`) — plus the published `describe`'s `email` / `phone`, which nothing honours. objectui has already had to reconcile two of them **inside its own package**, which is the strongest available evidence that the ambiguity is not theoretical.

### ④ A method note, recorded because it is the generalizable half

The reading that first said this key was unread came from grepping the cited evidence FILE for the KEY. It could not have found the truth whatever the truth was: the call site spells `resolveAutonumberFormat(def as never)` and the key never appears in that file. **A pointer to a file is not refuted by grepping that file for the key** — the read may be transitive through a resolver the contract itself publishes. Worth having on the record for whoever next audits a liveness evidence pointer, and it is a reason a `live` verdict carrying one file path is a thin instrument for a key like this one.

⚠️ Unchanged and still ⛔ not claimed: no exit is chosen here, and no census of authored documents was taken.

`Path: 业务对象与记录 | records-forms.field-type-matrix(P1) | P② | p2`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T19:12Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here, not in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body risks the platform's citation rewrite.

**Class (b), scoped deliberately.** The one arm with a quoted published line is the description: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1090` declares `format: z.string().optional().describe('Format string (e.g. email, phone)')`, and that sentence **ships** — `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx:59` renders it verbatim to a customer. Nothing honours `email` or `phone`. NORTH-STAR rule 4: 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」.

⚠️ **The scope line is the point of this grading.** The card also describes a wider problem — one `z.string()` key carrying several vocabularies (an autonumber pattern in the engine, a date display style in objectui). **That half is a contract-shape decision and is ⛔ NOT in this card's scope**: splitting or retiring the key widens or removes a published surface and belongs in the decision box as its own card. This round fixes the false sentence and ⛔ nothing else.

**⛔ Not (c)**: the card takes no census and names no producer, and (c) 须具名生产者.
